source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to disorders of the urinary tract (PDF 18-19).

blocks.text: Bohat si bimariyan (disorders) gurdon aur urinary tract (peshab ke raste) ki banawat aur kaam ko mutasir kar sakti hain. Aam bimariyan yeh hain: urinary tract infections, gurde ki pathri (kidney stones), gurdon ka kaam chhor dena (kidney failure) aur polycystic kidney disease (gurdon mein pani bhari thailiyan banna).

blocks.prompt: Peshab ki nali ki chaar aam bimariyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: Urinary tract infections, gurde ki pathri, kidney failure aur polycystic kidney disease.

items: Aam bimariyan: UTIs, kidney stones, kidney failure, polycystic kidney disease.
